newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish police hold 65 in squatter scuffles.
newsitem.headline: Spanish police hold 65 in squatter scuffles.

text.p: Spanish authorities detained 65 people on Monday in scuffles that erupted during an eviction of squatters living in an abandoned textile factory in Madrid, police said. Five people were slightly injured.
The squatters, who had lived in the building for a year and a half, prepared for the impending eviction by barricading doors and windows of the building.
Anti-riot forces broke through the metal fencing and other obstacles after the squatters refused to leave voluntarily.

Young people living in the old warehouse burned paper, broke windows, and threw firecrackers at police who responded by firing rubber bullets. Five minor injuries were reported, one of them a police officer.
The stand-off ended when police detained 35 protesters in front of the building and 30 of the squatters inside.
